name: sandbox-create-open-strict
about: The same with network.strict: refused instead, with a code.

response.error: network.open was asked for and not given: runc enforces its allow list inside the sandbox, which this node does not open to the whole internet; this sandbox on runc reaches nothing outside it (no allow list was given)
response.fix: list what the sandbox must reach in network.allow (within your org's ceiling; POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/network/allow adds more later), or choose isolation sealed or vault, whose targets give an open network through the host egress gateway; or leave network.strict out to accept the allow list
